faqs.q: Does the City provide free mulch?
faqs.a: The City is currently working on moving its free mulch pick-up site to a different location. Details of the new location will be posted as soon as they become available. The City hopes to have the new site open by June 2024. Once the new location is open, mulch will available on a first come, first served basis. Availability is not guaranteed.
